intended_object: Given a realizer of a topology on α (a basis of open sets indexed by σ), this is the induced realizer of the neighbourhood filter 𝓝 a: the basic open sets that contain a, which form a neighbourhood basis at a. Inferred from the docstring and from the Ctop/Realizer framework of the module.
explanation: The index type is the basic opens containing a, and each index maps to its set F.F s. Directedness comes from inter_mem/inter_sub and nonemptiness from top_mem. The proof shows the generated filter equals 𝓝 a, using mem_nhds_iff, openness of the basic sets (F.isOpen) and F.mem_nhds. This is exactly the standard fact that the basic open sets containing a point form a neighbourhood basis there. The definition assumes only a topological space with a realizer, so it is at its natural generality. Nothing is missing and no degenerate case is mishandled.
